info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Petadoption Pets Apply-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Application API facilitates the submission of pet adoption applications. This endpoint allows prospective pet owners to apply for adopting pets available at shelters or foster homes. Users can provide necessary information and preferences to express interest in specific animals. This API is particularly useful for animal welfare organizations and potential adopters seeking a streamlined application process. By enabling electronic submissions, it enhances user engagement and increases the chances of successful pet placements.
